meta.description: Every pathway after Class 10, Class 12/PU, ITI and Diploma: streams, diploma, ITI trades, defence entries, degrees and professional courses, with eligibility, exams, cost and outcomes.
meta.disclaimer: Curated for EduSelect from official and reputable public sources (compiled 2026-10-04). Fees and private-sector salaries are estimates (isEstimate=true) and must be shown with an 'Estimate' badge. Government pay is from the 7th CPC pay matrix (basic pay, excludes DA/HRA). Exam rules, age limits and fees change every cycle - re-check the official notification before relying on any value.

items.name: USMLE Clinical Licensure & US Residency Pathway
items.eligibility: Enrolled in or graduated from an ECFMG-recognized medical school (MBBS)

cost.note: Includes Step 1 ($695 + $210 region + 18% GST = ~₹99,510), Step 2 CK ($695 + $235 region + 18% GST = ~₹1,02,021), Step 3 ($955), ECFMG ($890 total = ~₹76,440), OET ($455 = ~₹38,220), USCE observerships, ERAS match fees and prep.

outcomes: US Residency placement (Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, Pathology, Surgery, Neurology)

global_mobility.critical_thresholds: Step 2 CK score 230+ for general specialties, 245+ for competitive specialties. Step 1 is Pass/Fail.

items.name: PLAB / UK MLA Pathway (General Medical Council UK)
items.eligibility: MBBS from recognized medical school + IELTS (7.5 overall) or OET Medicine (Grade B)

cost.note: Significantly more affordable than USMLE: PLAB 1 (£283 = ~₹35,941), PLAB 2 clinical (£1,036 = ~₹1,31,572), GMC registration (~£440). Core exams under ₹2 Lakhs.

outcomes: NHS Junior Doctor / Registrar appointment in the UK
Starting pay £34,000–£45,000/yr (₹36L–₹48L), progressing to NHS Consultant £93,000–£126,000/yr (₹99L–₹1.35Cr)

global_mobility.critical_thresholds: PLAB 1 pass + PLAB 2 clinical simulation in Manchester

items.name: B.Sc Nursing International Mobility (NCLEX-RN & CGFNS VisaScreen)
items.eligibility: B.Sc Nursing (4-year degree) + State Nursing Council Registration in India

cost.note: NCLEX-RN exam ($200 + international scheduling $150 = ~₹29,750), CGFNS VisaScreen ($540 = ~₹45,360), English test ($250). Universally accepted across all 50 US states for EB-3 Green Card.

outcomes: Permanent U.S. Green Card employment as Registered Nurse
Starting US salary $75,000–$105,000/yr (₹63L–₹88L) with overtime benefits

mandatory_certifications: State Board of Nursing RN Licensure
global_mobility.critical_thresholds: NCLEX-RN CAT passing standard + VisaScreen credential review in 3-6 months
global_mobility.regulatory_body: CGFNS International & State Boards of Nursing

items.name: Japan Specified Skilled Worker (SSW / Tokutei Ginou)
items.eligibility: Class 10 + ITI / Diploma / Degree; JLPT N4 or JFT-Basic language qualification (JLPT N3 preferred by employers; Nursing Care requires Nursing Care Japanese Evaluation Test 73% passing standard)
items.duration: Type 1: Up to 5 years; Type 2: Indefinite renewal with family & permanent residency

cost.note: Language training (JLPT N4/N3) + SSW skills assessment fees. NSDC / ESDP subsidized routes available.

nextSteps: Transition to SSW Type 2 (Indefinite stay, spouse/child visa)
outcomes: Guaranteed statutory parity with Japanese workers: Gross wages ¥200,000–¥260,000/month (₹1.15L–₹1.50L)
Net monthly savings after Shakai Hoken, taxes, and dormitory: ~₹64,000/month

mandatory_certifications: JLPT N4 or JFT-Basic (JLPT N3 highly recommended)
global_mobility.critical_thresholds: Passage of skills test + language exam. Type 2 allows indefinite stay and family accompaniment.

items.name: Germany Direct Higher Education & Research (APS Certified)
items.eligibility: Indian Bachelor's degree (B.Tech / 4-yr degree) or Class 12 with JEE Advanced / Studienkolleg; APS Certificate is mandatory

cost.note: Tuition is tuition-free at public universities across 15 German states (semester fee ~€250-350). Mandatory Blocked Account (Sperrkonto ~€11,208/yr). APS Verification Fee: EUR 225 (~₹23,025) non-refundable.

nextSteps: German EU Blue Card & Permanent Residency
outcomes: Zero tuition fees at elite German TU9 technical universities

global_mobility.critical_thresholds: DigiLocker document authentication with APS New Delhi before visa processing. DAAD/EU scholars exempt.

items.name: Apex Ph.D & Research Fellowship (UGC/CSIR JRF, PMRF, Fulbright-Nehru)
items.eligibility: Postgraduate degree (M.Sc / M.Tech / MA / MS) or direct B.Tech from CFTIs with CGPA ≥ 8.0

cost.note: Fully funded research phase: Scholars pay nominal semester fees and earn substantial monthly stipends exempt from TDS.

outcomes: UGC/CSIR NET: ₹37,000/mo (JRF) + ₹42,000/mo (SRF) + up to 27% HRA + ₹10k–₹25k contingency
PMRF Scheme: ₹70,000–₹80,000/mo + ₹2 Lakhs/year research grant (₹10L total)
Substantial financial independence during doctoral studies backed by ₹50,000 Cr ANRF funding
